candidate.model:
---- MODULE RecordingHandover ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC

CONSTANTS Recording, OtherRecording, MaxAttempts, MaxDifferences, MaxCleanupAttempts,
          OldReasonNone, OldReasonFolderGone, OldReasonFolderFull, OldReasonNameConflict, OldReasonDifferentCopies,
          OldReplyNone, OldReplyOk, OldReplyAbsent, OldReplySame, OldReplyDifferent, OldReplyTaken, OldReplyFolderGone, OldReplyFolderFull, OldReplyRemoveFailed

VARIABLES outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences,
          cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, execution,
          hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified,
          namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies,
          spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed

vars == <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences,
          cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, execution,
          hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified,
          namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies,
          spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>

\* Names are abstract path components; prefix is prepended to name by the caller.
HiddenName == [directory |-> "folder", prefix |-> ".", name |-> Recording]
FinalName == [directory |-> "folder", prefix |-> "", name |-> Recording]
SpoolName == [directory |-> "spool", prefix |-> "", name |-> Recording]
OtherName == [directory |-> "folder", prefix |-> "", name |-> OtherRecording]
Names == {HiddenName, FinalName, SpoolName, OtherName}
Kinds == {"none", "compareNamed", "copy", "compareHidden", "publish", "removeHidden", "removeSpool"}
Phases == {"idle", "inspect", "inspectTaken", "preclean", "copy", "verify", "discard", "publish", "retention", "terminal"}
LegacyReasons == {"none", "folderGone", "folderFull", "nameConflict", "differentCopies"}
Reasons == LegacyReasons \cup {"nameFreed", "copyGone", "folderRefused"}
LegacyReplies == {"none", "ok", "absent", "same", "different", "taken", "folderGone", "folderFull", "removeFailed"}
Replies == LegacyReplies \cup {"copyGone", "folderRefused"}
NoRequest == [kind |-> "none", target |-> HiddenName, token |-> <<0, 0, "idle", 0>>]
Request(kind, target, stage) ==
    [kind |-> kind, target |-> target, token |-> <<attempt, round, stage, cleanupTry>>]
Requests ==
    [kind : Kinds, target : Names,
     token : (0..MaxAttempts) \X (0..MaxDifferences) \X Phases \X (0..MaxCleanupAttempts)]
Terminal == outcome \in {"handedOver", "failed"}
FolderMutation(r) == r.kind \in {"copy", "publish", "removeHidden"}

\* Legacy numeric tables are inputs inherited from v0.1.0, not assignments
\* chosen by this amendment; the bounds provide representative tables only.
LegacyReasonCodes ==
    [none |-> OldReasonNone,
     folderGone |-> OldReasonFolderGone,
     folderFull |-> OldReasonFolderFull,
     nameConflict |-> OldReasonNameConflict,
     differentCopies |-> OldReasonDifferentCopies]

LegacyReplyCodes ==
    [none |-> OldReplyNone,
     ok |-> OldReplyOk,
     absent |-> OldReplyAbsent,
     same |-> OldReplySame,
     different |-> OldReplyDifferent,
     taken |-> OldReplyTaken,
     folderGone |-> OldReplyFolderGone,
     folderFull |-> OldReplyFolderFull,
     removeFailed |-> OldReplyRemoveFailed]

LargestNumber(table) ==
    CHOOSE n \in {table[k] : k \in DOMAIN table} :
        \A k \in DOMAIN table : table[k] <= n

ReasonNumbers ==
    [r \in Reasons |-> IF r \in LegacyReasons THEN LegacyReasonCodes[r]
                       ELSE LargestNumber(LegacyReasonCodes) +
                            CASE r = "nameFreed" -> 1
                                 [] r = "copyGone" -> 2
                                 [] r = "folderRefused" -> 3]

ReplyNumbers ==
    [r \in Replies |-> IF r \in LegacyReplies THEN LegacyReplyCodes[r]
                       ELSE LargestNumber(LegacyReplyCodes) +
                            IF r = "copyGone" THEN 1 ELSE 2]

PersistedNumbersCompatible ==
    /\ \A r \in LegacyReasons : ReasonNumbers[r] = LegacyReasonCodes[r]
    /\ \A r \in LegacyReplies : ReplyNumbers[r] = LegacyReplyCodes[r]
    /\ \A r \in Reasons \ LegacyReasons :
           ReasonNumbers[r] > LargestNumber(LegacyReasonCodes)
    /\ \A r \in Replies \ LegacyReplies :
           ReplyNumbers[r] > LargestNumber(LegacyReplyCodes)
    /\ \A r, s \in Reasons : r # s => ReasonNumbers[r] # ReasonNumbers[s]
    /\ \A r, s \in Replies : r # s => ReplyNumbers[r] # ReplyNumbers[s]

FolderKinds == {"compareNamed", "copy", "compareHidden", "publish", "removeHidden"}

\* execution and reply retain the last completed answer until Issue replaces
\* them; caller = "idle" distinguishes a handled answer from a pending one.
\* The attempt token excludes evidence from an earlier failed attempt.
ObservedFailureReason ==
    CASE execution.kind = "compareNamed" /\ execution.token[3] = "inspectTaken" /\ reply = "absent" -> "nameFreed"
         [] execution.kind = "publish" /\ reply = "copyGone" -> "copyGone"
         [] execution.kind \in FolderKinds /\ reply = "folderRefused" -> "folderRefused"
         [] OTHER -> "none"

NewFailuresEndAttempt ==
    (caller = "idle" /\ execution # NoRequest /\ execution.token[1] = attempt
     /\ ObservedFailureReason # "none") =>
        /\ outcome = "failed" /\ phase = "terminal" /\ reason = ObservedFailureReason
        /\ spool /\ intent = NoRequest /\ wire = NoRequest

HiddenComparisonReply(content) == IF content = "same" THEN "same" ELSE "different"

HiddenComparisonAnswers ==
    /\ HiddenComparisonReply("absent") = "different"
    /\ execution.kind = "compareHidden" =>
        reply \in {"same", "different", "folderGone", "folderFull", "folderRefused"}

RetryClearsVerification ==
    (outcome = "active" /\ execution # NoRequest /\ execution.token[1] < attempt) =>
        /\ ~hiddenVerified /\ phase \in {"preclean", "inspect"}
        /\ hidden # "absent" => phase = "preclean"

OnlyOwnedComparisons ==
    \A r \in {intent, wire} :
        /\ r.kind = "compareNamed" => r.target = FinalName
        /\ r.kind = "compareHidden" => r.target = HiddenName

\* The ratified contract is about requests and durable evidence, not disk code.
PublicationIsVerified ==
    /\ (intent.kind = "publish" \/ wire.kind = "publish") => hiddenVerified
    /\ publications > 0 => publicationVerified /\ named = "same"

SpoolRemovalIsSafe ==
    (intent.kind = "removeSpool" \/ wire.kind = "removeSpool" \/ ~spool)
        => outcome = "handedOver" /\ namedVerified /\ keepElapsed

NoCopyAfterPublication ==
    publications > 0 => intent.kind # "copy" /\ wire.kind # "copy"

OneCopyAtATime == activeCopies <= 1

ReplayKeepsIdentity ==
    /\ wire = NoRequest \/ wire = intent
    /\ caller # "idle" => execution = intent

OnlyOwnedNames ==
    \A r \in {intent, wire} :
        /\ FolderMutation(r) => r.target \in {HiddenName, FinalName}
        /\ r.kind \in {"copy", "removeHidden"} => r.target = HiddenName
        /\ r.kind = "publish" => r.target = FinalName
        /\ r.kind = "removeSpool" => r.target = SpoolName

CopiesAreHidden ==
    \A r \in {intent, wire} : r.kind = "copy" => r.target.prefix = "."

NewCopiesStartCleanly ==
    (intent.kind = "copy" /\ caller = "idle") => hidden = "absent"

DifferenceLimitStopsCopying ==
    differences = MaxDifferences /\ outcome = "active" => phase = "discard"

AtMostOnePublication == publications <= 1

ForeignFileIsPreserved == foreignContent # "absent" => named = foreignContent /\ publications = 0

SuccessHasEvidence == outcome = "handedOver" => named = "same" /\ namedVerified

FailureKeepsSpool == outcome = "failed" => spool /\ reason \in (Reasons \ {"none"})

DifferentCopyIsNotPublished == hidden = "different" => ~hiddenVerified

DifferenceLimitCleansUp == reason = "differentCopies" => differences = MaxDifferences /\ hidden = "absent"

ExistingMatchAvoidsCopy == initialNamed = "same" => copies = 0

CleanupCannotUndoDelivery == cleanup # "dormant" => outcome = "handedOver"

TypeOK ==
    /\ Recording # OtherRecording
    /\ LegacyReasonCodes \in [LegacyReasons -> Nat]
    /\ LegacyReplyCodes \in [LegacyReplies -> Nat]
    /\ MaxAttempts \in Nat \ {0} /\ MaxDifferences \in Nat \ {0} /\ MaxCleanupAttempts \in Nat \ {0}
    /\ outcome \in {"notStarted", "active", "handedOver", "failed"}
    /\ phase \in Phases /\ reason \in Reasons
    /\ attempt \in 0..MaxAttempts /\ round \in 0..MaxDifferences /\ differences \in 0..MaxDifferences
    /\ cleanup \in {"dormant", "waiting", "active", "failed", "done"}
    /\ cleanupReason \in {"none", "removeFailed"} /\ cleanupTry \in 0..MaxCleanupAttempts
    /\ intent \in Requests /\ wire \in Requests /\ execution \in Requests
    /\ caller \in {"idle", "busy", "done"} /\ reply \in Replies
    /\ hidden \in {"absent", "partial", "same", "different"}
    /\ named \in {"absent", "same", "different"}
    /\ foreignContent \in {"absent", "same", "different"} /\ initialNamed \in {"absent", "same", "different"}
    /\ hiddenVerified \in BOOLEAN /\ namedVerified \in BOOLEAN /\ publicationVerified \in BOOLEAN
    /\ publications \in 0..2 /\ copies \in 0..(MaxAttempts * MaxDifferences)
    /\ activeCopies \in 0..2 /\ spool \in BOOLEAN /\ keepElapsed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ running \in BOOLEAN /\ replayed \in BOOLEAN

DeliveredByCopy == outcome = "handedOver" /\ publications = 1 /\ spool
AcceptedExisting == outcome = "handedOver" /\ initialNamed = "same" /\ copies = 0
ConflictingName == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "nameConflict" /\ named = "different"
FolderGone == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "folderGone"
FolderFull == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "folderFull"
DifferencesExhausted == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "differentCopies" /\ hidden = "absent"
ReplacedDifferentCopy == outcome = "handedOver" /\ round > 1 /\ publications = 1
RetriedDelivery == outcome = "handedOver" /\ attempt > 1
RecoveredPublication == outcome = "handedOver" /\ publications = 1 /\ replayed
RetainingOriginal == outcome = "handedOver" /\ spool /\ ~keepElapsed
OriginalRemoved == outcome = "handedOver" /\ cleanup = "done" /\ ~spool
CleanupFailed == outcome = "handedOver" /\ cleanup = "failed" /\ spool
CleanupRetried == outcome = "handedOver" /\ cleanup = "done" /\ cleanupTry > 1

NameFreedFailure == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "nameFreed" /\ spool
CopyGoneFailure == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "copyGone" /\ spool
FolderRefusedFailure == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "folderRefused" /\ spool
FolderRefusedAtPublication ==
    /\ outcome = "failed" /\ phase = "terminal" /\ reason = "folderRefused" /\ spool
    /\ caller = "idle" /\ intent = NoRequest /\ wire = NoRequest
    /\ execution.kind = "publish" /\ execution.token[1] = attempt /\ execution.token[3] = "publish"
    /\ reply = "folderRefused" /\ hiddenVerified /\ hidden = "same"
    /\ named = "absent" /\ publications = 0
MissingHiddenDiffers ==
    caller = "done" /\ execution.kind = "compareHidden" /\ hidden = "absent" /\ reply = "different"
RetryAfterNameFreed ==
    outcome = "active" /\ attempt > execution.token[1] /\ ObservedFailureReason = "nameFreed"
    /\ phase = "preclean" /\ hidden # "absent" /\ ~hiddenVerified
RetryAfterCopyGone ==
    outcome = "active" /\ attempt > execution.token[1] /\ ObservedFailureReason = "copyGone"
    /\ phase = "inspect" /\ ~hiddenVerified
RetryAfterFolderRefusal ==
    outcome = "active" /\ attempt > execution.token[1] /\ ObservedFailureReason = "folderRefused"
    /\ phase = "preclean" /\ hidden # "absent" /\ ~hiddenVerified

\* No fairness is imposed on the caller or the passage of retention time.
\* A caller that never resumes or never supplies an outstanding result has
\* interrupted the hand-over for good, and is outside this progress promise.
CallerContinues == ([]<>running) /\ ((intent # NoRequest) ~> (caller = "done"))
StartedAttemptFinishes == CallerContinues => ((outcome = "active") ~> Terminal)

Init ==
    /\ outcome = "notStarted" /\ phase = "idle" /\ reason = "none"
    /\ attempt = 0 /\ round = 0 /\ differences = 0
    /\ cleanup = "dormant" /\ cleanupReason = "none" /\ cleanupTry = 0
    /\ intent = NoRequest /\ wire = NoRequest /\ caller = "idle" /\ reply = "none"
    /\ hidden = "absent" /\ named = "absent"
    /\ foreignContent = named /\ initialNamed = named
    /\ hiddenVerified = FALSE /\ namedVerified = FALSE /\ publicationVerified = FALSE
    /\ publications = 0 /\ copies = 0 /\ activeCopies = 0
    /\ spool = TRUE /\ keepElapsed = FALSE /\ running = TRUE /\ replayed = FALSE
    /\ execution = NoRequest

\* Start and retry are caller choices; attempts are bounded only for exploration.
Start ==
    /\ running /\ outcome = "notStarted"
    /\ outcome' = "active" /\ phase' = "inspect" /\ attempt' = 1 /\ round' = 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reason, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply,
                   hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified,
                   publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

RetryDelivery ==
    /\ running /\ outcome = "failed" /\ attempt < MaxAttempts
    /\ outcome' = "active" /\ reason' = "none" /\ attempt' = attempt + 1
    /\ round' = 1 /\ differences' = 0 /\ hiddenVerified' = FALSE
    /\ phase' = IF hidden = "absent" THEN "inspect" ELSE "preclean"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, hidden, named,
                   foreignContent, initialNamed, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

Issue ==
    /\ running /\ intent = NoRequest /\ (outcome = "active" \/ cleanup = "active")
    /\ LET r == CASE phase \in {"inspect", "inspectTaken"} -> Request("compareNamed", FinalName, phase)
                     [] phase = "preclean" -> Request("removeHidden", HiddenName, phase)
                     [] phase = "copy" -> Request("copy", HiddenName, phase)
                     [] phase = "verify" -> Request("compareHidden", HiddenName, phase)
                     [] phase = "discard" -> Request("removeHidden", HiddenName, phase)
                     [] phase = "publish" -> Request("publish", FinalName, phase)
                     [] phase = "retention" -> Request("removeSpool", SpoolName, phase)
       IN intent' = r /\ wire' = r
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, caller, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ execution' = NoRequest /\ reply' = "none"

Resend ==
    /\ running /\ intent # NoRequest /\ wire = NoRequest
    /\ wire' = intent
    /\ replayed' = (replayed \/ (intent.kind = "publish" /\ reply = "ok"))
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

\* The caller adapter executes an identity once, caches its result, and shares
\* an in-flight copy with all repetitions. These are the settled caller rules.
BeginCopy ==
    /\ wire.kind = "copy" /\ caller = "idle"
    /\ caller' = "busy" /\ hidden' = "partial" /\ activeCopies' = 1 /\ copies' = copies + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, reply, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ execution' = wire

FinishCopy(result, content) ==
    /\ caller = "busy"
    /\ result \in {"ok", "folderGone", "folderFull", "folderRefused"}
    /\ content \in IF result = "ok" THEN {"same", "different"} ELSE {"partial"}
    /\ reply' = result /\ hidden' = content
    /\ caller' = "done" /\ activeCopies' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

ExecuteOther(r) ==
    /\ wire # NoRequest /\ wire.kind # "copy" /\ caller = "idle"
    /\ caller' = "done"
    /\ r \in CASE wire.kind = "compareNamed" -> {named, "folderGone", "folderFull", "folderRefused"}
                     [] wire.kind = "compareHidden" -> {HiddenComparisonReply(hidden), "folderGone", "folderFull", "folderRefused"}
                     [] wire.kind = "publish" -> {"folderGone", "folderFull", "folderRefused"}
                         \cup (IF hidden = "absent" THEN {"copyGone"} ELSE {})
                         \cup (IF named # "absent" THEN {"taken"} ELSE {})
                         \cup (IF hidden # "absent" /\ named = "absent" THEN {"ok"} ELSE {})
                     [] wire.kind = "removeHidden" -> {"ok", "folderGone", "folderFull", "folderRefused"}
                     [] wire.kind = "removeSpool" -> {"ok", "removeFailed"}
    /\ reply' = r
    /\ hidden' = IF r = "ok" /\ wire.kind \in {"publish", "removeHidden"} THEN "absent" ELSE hidden
    /\ named' = IF r = "ok" /\ wire.kind = "publish" THEN hidden ELSE named
    /\ publications' = IF r = "ok" /\ wire.kind = "publish" THEN publications + 1 ELSE publications
    /\ publicationVerified' = IF r = "ok" /\ wire.kind = "publish" THEN hiddenVerified ELSE publicationVerified
    /\ spool' = IF r = "ok" /\ wire.kind = "removeSpool" THEN FALSE ELSE spool
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified,
                   namedVerified, copies, activeCopies, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ execution' = wire

Consume ==
    /\ running /\ intent # NoRequest /\ wire = intent /\ caller = "done"
    /\ intent' = NoRequest /\ wire' = NoRequest /\ caller' = "idle"
    /\ LET failed == reply \in {"folderGone", "folderFull"} \/ ObservedFailureReason # "none"
           success == (phase \in {"inspect", "inspectTaken"} /\ reply = "same") \/ (phase = "publish" /\ reply = "ok")
           conflict == phase \in {"inspect", "inspectTaken"} /\ reply = "different"
           exhausted == phase = "discard" /\ reply = "ok" /\ differences = MaxDifferences
       IN /\ outcome' = IF phase = "retention" THEN outcome
                         ELSE IF failed \/ conflict \/ exhausted THEN "failed"
                         ELSE IF success THEN "handedOver" ELSE outcome
          /\ reason' = IF ObservedFailureReason # "none" THEN ObservedFailureReason
                        ELSE IF failed THEN reply ELSE IF conflict THEN "nameConflict"
                        ELSE IF exhausted THEN "differentCopies" ELSE reason
          /\ phase' = IF failed \/ conflict \/ exhausted \/ success \/ phase = "retention" THEN "terminal"
                       ELSE CASE phase = "inspect" -> "copy"
                                 [] phase = "preclean" -> "inspect"
                                 [] phase = "copy" -> "verify"
                                 [] phase = "verify" -> IF reply = "same" THEN "publish" ELSE "discard"
                                 [] phase = "discard" -> "copy"
                                 [] phase = "publish" -> "inspectTaken"
          /\ differences' = IF phase = "verify" /\ reply = "different" THEN differences + 1 ELSE differences
          /\ round' = IF phase = "discard" /\ reply = "ok" /\ ~exhausted THEN round + 1 ELSE round
          /\ hiddenVerified' = IF phase = "verify" /\ reply = "same" THEN TRUE
                                ELSE IF phase \in {"preclean", "discard"} /\ reply = "ok" THEN FALSE
                                ELSE hiddenVerified
          /\ namedVerified' = (namedVerified \/ success)
          /\ cleanup' = IF success THEN "waiting"
                         ELSE IF phase = "retention" THEN IF reply = "ok" THEN "done" ELSE "failed"
                         ELSE cleanup
          /\ cleanupReason' = IF phase = "retention" /\ reply = "removeFailed" THEN "removeFailed" ELSE cleanupReason
    /\ UNCHANGED <<attempt, cleanupTry, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<execution, reply>>

BeginRetention ==
    /\ running /\ outcome = "handedOver" /\ cleanup = "waiting" /\ keepElapsed
    /\ cleanup' = "active" /\ cleanupTry' = 1 /\ phase' = "retention"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanupReason, intent, wire,
                   caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified,
                   namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies,
                   spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

RetryCleanup ==
    /\ running /\ cleanup = "failed" /\ cleanupTry < MaxCleanupAttempts
    /\ cleanup' = "active" /\ cleanupReason' = "none" /\ cleanupTry' = cleanupTry + 1 /\ phase' = "retention"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, reason, attempt, round, differences, intent, wire, caller, reply,
                   hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified,
                   publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

\* The environment may take the final name even between its comparison and
\* publication. Publication is non-replacing and reports that collision.
NameAppears(content) ==
    /\ outcome = "active" /\ named = "absent"
    /\ content \in {"same", "different"}
    /\ named' = content /\ foreignContent' = content
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, hidden, initialNamed, hiddenVerified,
                   namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies,
                   spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

\* Interference before the taken-name comparison, including while copying.
\* A cached positive comparison is already delivery evidence: removal after
\* that observation or after publication is outside this amendment's races.
NameFreed ==
    /\ outcome = "active" /\ publications = 0 /\ foreignContent # "absent"
    /\ phase \in {"copy", "verify", "discard", "publish", "inspectTaken"}
    /\ ~(caller = "done" /\ execution.kind = "compareNamed" /\ reply = "same")
    /\ named' = "absent" /\ foreignContent' = "absent"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, execution, hidden, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>

\* Removal of a completed hidden copy does not erase historical verification;
\* a later publication must report copyGone instead of claiming success.
HiddenRemoved ==
    /\ outcome = "active" /\ publications = 0 /\ hidden # "absent" /\ caller # "busy"
    /\ hidden' = "absent"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, execution, named, foreignContent,
                   initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>

RetentionElapsed ==
    /\ ~keepElapsed /\ keepElapsed' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent,
                   initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   copies, activeCopies, spool, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

Crash ==
    /\ running /\ running' = FALSE /\ wire' = NoRequest
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

Resume ==
    /\ ~running /\ running' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

\* Stopping or waiting for the caller is legitimate and never a deadlock.
Wait == UNCHANGED vars

Drive == Issue \/ Resend \/ Consume \/ BeginRetention
IssueProgress == SF_vars(Issue)
ResendProgress == SF_vars(Resend)
ConsumeProgress == SF_vars(Consume)
RetentionProgress == SF_vars(BeginRetention)

\* Single-root exploration: choose a pre-existing file before starting.
InitialFile(content) ==
    /\ outcome = "notStarted" /\ named = "absent"
    /\ content \in {"same", "different"}
    /\ named' = content /\ foreignContent' = content /\ initialNamed' = content
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences,
                   cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply,
                   execution, hidden, hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified,
                   publications, copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>

Next == Start \/ RetryDelivery \/ Issue \/ Resend \/ Consume \/ BeginRetention \/ BeginCopy
        \/ (\E result \in {"ok", "folderGone", "folderFull", "folderRefused"}, content \in {"same", "different", "partial"} : FinishCopy(result, content))
        \/ (\E r \in Replies : ExecuteOther(r))
        \/ RetryCleanup
        \/ (\E content \in {"same", "different"} : NameAppears(content))
        \/ (\E content \in {"same", "different"} : InitialFile(content))
        \/ NameFreed \/ HiddenRemoved
        \/ RetentionElapsed \/ Crash \/ Resume \/ Wait

\* Reported v0.1.0 gaps: reject the truthful answer and leave its saved
\* request outstanding; only the caller bookkeeping returns to idle.
IgnoreFreedName ==
    /\ running /\ caller = "done" /\ wire = intent
    /\ execution.kind = "compareNamed" /\ execution.token[3] = "inspectTaken" /\ reply = "absent"
    /\ caller' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, reply, execution, hidden, named, foreignContent,
                   initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>

RejectCopyGone ==
    /\ running /\ caller = "done" /\ wire = intent
    /\ execution.kind = "publish" /\ reply = "copyGone"
    /\ caller' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, reply, execution, hidden, named, foreignContent,
                   initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>

RejectFolderRefusal ==
    /\ running /\ caller = "done" /\ wire = intent
    /\ execution.kind = "publish" /\ reply = "folderRefused"
    /\ caller' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, reply, execution, hidden, named, foreignContent,
                   initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>

\* A plausible unsafe response treats an absent taken name as a verified
\* match, falsely recording delivery and allowing later spool removal.
FreedNameAsSame ==
    /\ running /\ outcome = "active" /\ phase = "inspectTaken"
    /\ caller = "done" /\ intent # NoRequest /\ wire = intent
    /\ execution.kind = "compareNamed" /\ execution.token[3] = "inspectTaken" /\ reply = "absent"
    /\ named = "absent"
    /\ caller' = "idle" /\ intent' = NoRequest /\ wire' = NoRequest
    /\ outcome' = "handedOver" /\ phase' = "terminal"
    /\ namedVerified' = TRUE /\ cleanup' = "waiting"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, reply, execution, hidden, named, foreignContent,
                   initialNamed, hiddenVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>

\* A plausible misclassification must not disguise a freed name as conflict.
FreedNameAsConflict ==
    /\ running /\ caller = "done" /\ wire = intent
    /\ execution.kind = "compareNamed" /\ execution.token[3] = "inspectTaken" /\ reply = "absent"
    /\ caller' = "idle" /\ intent' = NoRequest /\ wire' = NoRequest
    /\ outcome' = "failed" /\ phase' = "terminal" /\ reason' = "nameConflict"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, reply, execution, hidden, named, foreignContent,
                   initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>

MissingHiddenAsAbsent ==
    /\ wire.kind = "compareHidden" /\ caller = "idle" /\ hidden = "absent"
    /\ caller' = "done" /\ execution' = wire /\ reply' = "absent"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, hidden, named, foreignContent,
                   initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>

\* Mutation tests emit the unsafe request, before any file effect is needed.
PublishUnchecked ==
    /\ running /\ phase = "verify" /\ intent = NoRequest
    /\ intent' = Request("publish", FinalName, "publish") /\ wire' = intent'
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

RemoveSpoolEarly ==
    /\ running /\ outcome = "active" /\ intent = NoRequest
    /\ intent' = Request("removeSpool", SpoolName, "retention") /\ wire' = intent'
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

RestartAfterUnrecordedPublication ==
    /\ running /\ intent.kind = "publish" /\ reply = "ok" /\ wire = NoRequest
    /\ wire' = Request("copy", HiddenName, "copy")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

CopyWhileBusy ==
    /\ caller = "busy" /\ activeCopies = 1
    /\ activeCopies' = 2
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent,
                   initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   copies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

RemoveUnrelatedFile ==
    /\ running /\ phase = "discard" /\ intent = NoRequest
    /\ intent' = Request("removeHidden", OtherName, "discard") /\ wire' = intent'
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====

statements.name: Spec
statements.says: The hand-over starts in its initial state and proceeds through the modeled core and caller steps.

statements.name: PublicationIsVerified
statements.says: The core requests publication only after the hidden copy was found identical to the spool file, and every publication carries that evidence.

statements.name: SpoolRemovalIsSafe
statements.says: The original is requested for removal or removed only after verified delivery and expiry of its retention time.

statements.name: NoCopyAfterPublication
statements.says: Once the recording has been published, the core never requests another copy, including after an interruption before recording success.

statements.name: OneCopyAtATime
statements.says: At most one copy of the recording is being executed at a time.

statements.name: ReplayKeepsIdentity
statements.says: A repeated request retains the saved operation, names and identity, including while its execution or result is outstanding.

statements.name: OnlyOwnedNames
statements.says: Every request to change or remove a file targets only the appropriate hidden name, recording name or original spool file belonging to this hand-over.

statements.name: CopiesAreHidden
statements.says: Every copy request uses the hand-over’s hidden name with a leading dot.

statements.name: NewCopiesStartCleanly
statements.says: A new copy is requested only after any previous hidden copy has been removed.

statements.name: DifferenceLimitStopsCopying
statements.says: Reaching the configured limit of differing copies permits only their cleanup before the attempt finishes.

statements.name: AtMostOnePublication
statements.says: The recording is published at most once across all interruptions and retries.

statements.name: ForeignFileIsPreserved
statements.says: A file already occupying the final name is never replaced or removed by this hand-over.

statements.name: SuccessHasEvidence
statements.says: A successful hand-over has an identical file at its final name and recorded verification evidence.

statements.name: FailureKeepsSpool
statements.says: A failed hand-over records its reason and retains the original spool file.

statements.name: DifferentCopyIsNotPublished
statements.says: A differing hidden copy never carries permission to be published.

statements.name: DifferenceLimitCleansUp
statements.says: An attempt that fails for exhausting its differing-copy limit has removed the last differing copy.

statements.name: ExistingMatchAvoidsCopy
statements.says: An identical file present at the final name when the hand-over begins is accepted without making a copy.

statements.name: CleanupCannotUndoDelivery
statements.says: Waiting for retention, removing the original, or failing and retrying that removal leaves the hand-over successful.

statements.name: TypeOK
statements.says: Every state component stays within its declared type and exploration bounds.

statements.name: NewFailuresEndAttempt
statements.says: Handling an absent taken name, a missing copy at publication or a permanent folder refusal ends that attempt with its distinct reason, no outstanding request and the original kept.

statements.name: HiddenComparisonAnswers
statements.says: A hidden-copy comparison answers same or different, including different for an absent copy, unless it reports a folder failure.

statements.name: RetryClearsVerification
statements.says: A new attempt clears previous hidden-copy verification and starts by cleaning any remaining hidden copy before inspecting the final name.

statements.name: OnlyOwnedComparisons
statements.says: Comparison requests in the folder target only the hand-over’s hidden name or recording name.

statements.name: PersistedNumbersCompatible
statements.says: Every existing reason and answer keeps its v0.1.0 numeric value, and each new value is distinct and greater than every existing value of its kind.

statements.name: DeliveredByCopy
statements.says: A new copy can be verified and published while the original remains in the spool.

statements.name: AcceptedExisting
statements.says: An identical existing file can be accepted without copying.

statements.name: ConflictingName
statements.says: A differing existing file can cause a name-conflict failure while remaining unchanged.

statements.name: FolderGone
statements.says: A missing folder can end the hand-over with that failure reason.

statements.name: FolderFull
statements.says: A full folder can end the hand-over with that failure reason.

statements.name: DifferencesExhausted
statements.says: Repeated differing copies can reach the limit, be cleaned up and produce the specified failure.

statements.name: ReplacedDifferentCopy
statements.says: A differing copy can be removed and replaced by a copy that is successfully handed over.

statements.name: RetriedDelivery
statements.says: A failed hand-over can be retried successfully.

statements.name: RecoveredPublication
statements.says: An interruption after publication but before recording success can be recovered by repeating the original request.

statements.name: RetainingOriginal
statements.says: A successful hand-over can retain its original while the retention time has not elapsed.

statements.name: OriginalRemoved
statements.says: The original can be removed after successful hand-over and expiry of retention.

statements.name: CleanupFailed
statements.says: Removal of the original can fail while the hand-over stays successful and the original remains.

statements.name: CleanupRetried
statements.says: A failed removal of the original can be retried successfully.

statements.name: IssueProgress
statements.says: If issuing the next saved request is possible repeatedly, the core eventually issues it.

statements.name: ResendProgress
statements.says: If repeating an interrupted request is possible repeatedly, the core eventually repeats it.

statements.name: ConsumeProgress
statements.says: If recording a completed caller result is possible repeatedly, the core eventually records it.

statements.name: RetentionProgress
statements.says: If starting original removal after retention is possible repeatedly, the core eventually starts it.

statements.name: StartedAttemptFinishes
statements.says: If execution keeps resuming and the caller eventually answers outstanding requests, each started attempt eventually reports success or failure.

statements.name: PublishUnchecked
statements.says: The core requests publication before comparing the copy.

statements.name: RemoveSpoolEarly
statements.says: The core requests removal of the original before delivery.

statements.name: RestartAfterUnrecordedPublication
statements.says: After an interrupted publication, recovery requests a fresh copy instead of repeating the saved publication request.

statements.name: CopyWhileBusy
statements.says: A second copy is started while the first copy is still in progress.

statements.name: RemoveUnrelatedFile
statements.says: Discarding a differing copy mistakenly requests removal of an unrelated file.

statements.name: NameFreedFailure
statements.says: A taken name can disappear before comparison and end the attempt with the name-freed reason and the original kept.

statements.name: CopyGoneFailure
statements.says: A verified hidden copy can disappear before publication and end the attempt with the copy-gone reason and the original kept.

statements.name: FolderRefusedFailure
statements.says: A permanently refused folder step can end the attempt with the folder-refused reason and the original kept.

statements.name: FolderRefusedAtPublication
statements.says: Publication can be permanently refused after the hidden copy was found identical, ending the attempt with the folder-refused reason and the original kept.

statements.name: MissingHiddenDiffers
statements.says: A hidden copy can disappear before comparison and be answered as different.

statements.name: RetryAfterNameFreed
statements.says: After a name-freed failure the caller can start another attempt by removing the remaining hidden copy with its old verification cleared.

statements.name: RetryAfterCopyGone
statements.says: After a copy-gone failure the caller can start another attempt with no hidden copy and no old verification.

statements.name: RetryAfterFolderRefusal
statements.says: After a folder-refused failure the caller can start another attempt by cleaning the remaining hidden copy with its old verification cleared.

statements.name: IgnoreFreedName
statements.says: The core leaves the taken-name comparison outstanding after the caller reports that the name is absent.

statements.name: RejectCopyGone
statements.says: The core leaves publication outstanding after the caller reports that the hidden copy is gone.

statements.name: RejectFolderRefusal
statements.says: The core leaves publication outstanding after the caller reports a permanent folder refusal.

statements.name: FreedNameAsSame
statements.says: The core counts the hand-over as successful when comparison finds that the taken name is absent.

statements.name: FreedNameAsConflict
statements.says: The core records a name conflict when comparison finds that the taken name is absent.

statements.name: MissingHiddenAsAbsent
statements.says: The caller answers a missing hidden-copy comparison as absent instead of different.

comparison.scope: Bounds differ: changes describe the displayed scope of each complete bounded exploration, not a common checking scope.

unavailable.message: Comparison unavailable: at least one complete exploration exceeds 500 states. No empty or partial graph is substituted; mappings and hiding for that source were not evaluated.

statements.name: Spec
statements.says: The hand-over starts in its initial state and proceeds through the modeled core and caller steps.

statements.name: PublicationIsVerified
statements.says: The core requests publication only after the hidden copy was found identical to the spool file, and every publication carries that evidence.

statements.name: SpoolRemovalIsSafe
statements.says: The original is requested for removal or removed only after verified delivery and expiry of its retention time.

statements.name: NoCopyAfterPublication
statements.says: Once the recording has been published, the core never requests another copy, including after an interruption before recording success.

statements.name: OneCopyAtATime
statements.says: At most one copy of the recording is being executed at a time.

statements.name: ReplayKeepsIdentity
statements.says: A repeated request retains the saved operation, names and identity, including while its execution or result is outstanding.

statements.name: OnlyOwnedNames
statements.says: Every request to change or remove a file targets only the appropriate hidden name, recording name or original spool file belonging to this hand-over.

statements.name: CopiesAreHidden
statements.says: Every copy request uses the hand-over’s hidden name with a leading dot.

statements.name: NewCopiesStartCleanly
statements.says: A new copy is requested only after any previous hidden copy has been removed.

statements.name: DifferenceLimitStopsCopying
statements.says: Reaching the configured limit of differing copies permits only their cleanup before the attempt finishes.

statements.name: AtMostOnePublication
statements.says: The recording is published at most once across all interruptions and retries.

statements.name: ForeignFileIsPreserved
statements.says: A file already occupying the final name is never replaced or removed by this hand-over.

statements.name: SuccessHasEvidence
statements.says: A successful hand-over has an identical file at its final name and recorded verification evidence.

statements.name: FailureKeepsSpool
statements.says: A failed hand-over records its reason and retains the original spool file.

statements.name: DifferentCopyIsNotPublished
statements.says: A differing hidden copy never carries permission to be published.

statements.name: DifferenceLimitCleansUp
statements.says: An attempt that fails for exhausting its differing-copy limit has removed the last differing copy.

statements.name: ExistingMatchAvoidsCopy
statements.says: An identical file present at the final name when the hand-over begins is accepted without making a copy.

statements.name: CleanupCannotUndoDelivery
statements.says: Waiting for retention, removing the original, or failing and retrying that removal leaves the hand-over successful.

statements.name: TypeOK
statements.says: Every state component stays within its declared type and exploration bounds.

statements.name: DeliveredByCopy
statements.says: A new copy can be verified and published while the original remains in the spool.

statements.name: AcceptedExisting
statements.says: An identical existing file can be accepted without copying.

statements.name: ConflictingName
statements.says: A differing existing file can cause a name-conflict failure while remaining unchanged.

statements.name: FolderGone
statements.says: A missing folder can end the hand-over with that failure reason.

statements.name: FolderFull
statements.says: A full folder can end the hand-over with that failure reason.

statements.name: DifferencesExhausted
statements.says: Repeated differing copies can reach the limit, be cleaned up and produce the specified failure.

statements.name: ReplacedDifferentCopy
statements.says: A differing copy can be removed and replaced by a copy that is successfully handed over.

statements.name: RetriedDelivery
statements.says: A failed hand-over can be retried successfully.

statements.name: RecoveredPublication
statements.says: An interruption after publication but before recording success can be recovered by repeating the original request.

statements.name: RetainingOriginal
statements.says: A successful hand-over can retain its original while the retention time has not elapsed.

statements.name: OriginalRemoved
statements.says: The original can be removed after successful hand-over and expiry of retention.

statements.name: CleanupFailed
statements.says: Removal of the original can fail while the hand-over stays successful and the original remains.

statements.name: CleanupRetried
statements.says: A failed removal of the original can be retried successfully.

statements.name: IssueProgress
statements.says: If issuing the next saved request is possible repeatedly, the core eventually issues it.

statements.name: ResendProgress
statements.says: If repeating an interrupted request is possible repeatedly, the core eventually repeats it.

statements.name: ConsumeProgress
statements.says: If recording a completed caller result is possible repeatedly, the core eventually records it.

statements.name: RetentionProgress
statements.says: If starting original removal after retention is possible repeatedly, the core eventually starts it.

statements.name: StartedAttemptFinishes
statements.says: If execution keeps resuming and the caller eventually answers outstanding requests, each started attempt eventually reports success or failure.

statements.name: PublishUnchecked
statements.says: The core requests publication before comparing the copy.

statements.name: RemoveSpoolEarly
statements.says: The core requests removal of the original before delivery.

statements.name: RestartAfterUnrecordedPublication
statements.says: After an interrupted publication, recovery requests a fresh copy instead of repeating the saved publication request.

statements.name: CopyWhileBusy
statements.says: A second copy is started while the first copy is still in progress.

statements.name: RemoveUnrelatedFile
statements.says: Discarding a differing copy mistakenly requests removal of an unrelated file.

baseline.ModuleText:
---- MODULE RecordingHandover ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC

CONSTANTS Recording, OtherRecording, MaxAttempts, MaxDifferences, MaxCleanupAttempts

VARIABLES outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences,
          cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, execution,
          hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified,
          namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies,
          spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed

vars == <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences,
          cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, execution,
          hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified,
          namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies,
          spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>

\* Names are abstract path components; prefix is prepended to name by the caller.
HiddenName == [directory |-> "folder", prefix |-> ".", name |-> Recording]
FinalName == [directory |-> "folder", prefix |-> "", name |-> Recording]
SpoolName == [directory |-> "spool", prefix |-> "", name |-> Recording]
OtherName == [directory |-> "folder", prefix |-> "", name |-> OtherRecording]
Names == {HiddenName, FinalName, SpoolName, OtherName}
Kinds == {"none", "compareNamed", "copy", "compareHidden", "publish", "removeHidden", "removeSpool"}
Phases == {"idle", "inspect", "inspectTaken", "preclean", "copy", "verify", "discard", "publish", "retention", "terminal"}
Reasons == {"none", "folderGone", "folderFull", "nameConflict", "differentCopies"}
Replies == {"none", "ok", "absent", "same", "different", "taken", "folderGone", "folderFull", "removeFailed"}
NoRequest == [kind |-> "none", target |-> HiddenName, token |-> <<0, 0, "idle", 0>>]
Request(kind, target, stage) ==
    [kind |-> kind, target |-> target, token |-> <<attempt, round, stage, cleanupTry>>]
Requests ==
    [kind : Kinds, target : Names,
     token : (0..MaxAttempts) \X (0..MaxDifferences) \X Phases \X (0..MaxCleanupAttempts)]
Terminal == outcome \in {"handedOver", "failed"}
FolderMutation(r) == r.kind \in {"copy", "publish", "removeHidden"}

\* The ratified contract is about requests and durable evidence, not disk code.
PublicationIsVerified ==
    /\ (intent.kind = "publish" \/ wire.kind = "publish") => hiddenVerified
    /\ publications > 0 => publicationVerified /\ named = "same"

SpoolRemovalIsSafe ==
    (intent.kind = "removeSpool" \/ wire.kind = "removeSpool" \/ ~spool)
        => outcome = "handedOver" /\ namedVerified /\ keepElapsed

NoCopyAfterPublication ==
    publications > 0 => intent.kind # "copy" /\ wire.kind # "copy"

OneCopyAtATime == activeCopies <= 1

ReplayKeepsIdentity ==
    /\ wire = NoRequest \/ wire = intent
    /\ caller # "idle" => execution = intent

OnlyOwnedNames ==
    \A r \in {intent, wire} :
        /\ FolderMutation(r) => r.target \in {HiddenName, FinalName}
        /\ r.kind \in {"copy", "removeHidden"} => r.target = HiddenName
        /\ r.kind = "publish" => r.target = FinalName
        /\ r.kind = "removeSpool" => r.target = SpoolName

CopiesAreHidden ==
    \A r \in {intent, wire} : r.kind = "copy" => r.target.prefix = "."

NewCopiesStartCleanly ==
    (intent.kind = "copy" /\ caller = "idle") => hidden = "absent"

DifferenceLimitStopsCopying ==
    differences = MaxDifferences /\ outcome = "active" => phase = "discard"

AtMostOnePublication == publications <= 1

ForeignFileIsPreserved == foreignContent # "absent" => named = foreignContent /\ publications = 0

SuccessHasEvidence == outcome = "handedOver" => named = "same" /\ namedVerified

FailureKeepsSpool == outcome = "failed" => spool /\ reason \in (Reasons \ {"none"})

DifferentCopyIsNotPublished == hidden = "different" => ~hiddenVerified

DifferenceLimitCleansUp == reason = "differentCopies" => differences = MaxDifferences /\ hidden = "absent"

ExistingMatchAvoidsCopy == initialNamed = "same" => copies = 0

CleanupCannotUndoDelivery == cleanup # "dormant" => outcome = "handedOver"

TypeOK ==
    /\ Recording # OtherRecording
    /\ MaxAttempts \in Nat \ {0} /\ MaxDifferences \in Nat \ {0} /\ MaxCleanupAttempts \in Nat \ {0}
    /\ outcome \in {"notStarted", "active", "handedOver", "failed"}
    /\ phase \in Phases /\ reason \in Reasons
    /\ attempt \in 0..MaxAttempts /\ round \in 0..MaxDifferences /\ differences \in 0..MaxDifferences
    /\ cleanup \in {"dormant", "waiting", "active", "failed", "done"}
    /\ cleanupReason \in {"none", "removeFailed"} /\ cleanupTry \in 0..MaxCleanupAttempts
    /\ intent \in Requests /\ wire \in Requests /\ execution \in Requests
    /\ caller \in {"idle", "busy", "done"} /\ reply \in Replies
    /\ hidden \in {"absent", "partial", "same", "different"}
    /\ named \in {"absent", "same", "different"}
    /\ foreignContent \in {"absent", "same", "different"} /\ initialNamed \in {"absent", "same", "different"}
    /\ hiddenVerified \in BOOLEAN /\ namedVerified \in BOOLEAN /\ publicationVerified \in BOOLEAN
    /\ publications \in 0..2 /\ copies \in 0..(MaxAttempts * MaxDifferences)
    /\ activeCopies \in 0..2 /\ spool \in BOOLEAN /\ keepElapsed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ running \in BOOLEAN /\ replayed \in BOOLEAN

DeliveredByCopy == outcome = "handedOver" /\ publications = 1 /\ spool
AcceptedExisting == outcome = "handedOver" /\ initialNamed = "same" /\ copies = 0
ConflictingName == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "nameConflict" /\ named = "different"
FolderGone == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "folderGone"
FolderFull == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "folderFull"
DifferencesExhausted == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "differentCopies" /\ hidden = "absent"
ReplacedDifferentCopy == outcome = "handedOver" /\ round > 1 /\ publications = 1
RetriedDelivery == outcome = "handedOver" /\ attempt > 1
RecoveredPublication == outcome = "handedOver" /\ publications = 1 /\ replayed
RetainingOriginal == outcome = "handedOver" /\ spool /\ ~keepElapsed
OriginalRemoved == outcome = "handedOver" /\ cleanup = "done" /\ ~spool
CleanupFailed == outcome = "handedOver" /\ cleanup = "failed" /\ spool
CleanupRetried == outcome = "handedOver" /\ cleanup = "done" /\ cleanupTry > 1

\* No fairness is imposed on the caller or the passage of retention time.
\* A caller that never resumes or never supplies an outstanding result has
\* interrupted the hand-over for good, and is outside this progress promise.
CallerContinues == ([]<>running) /\ ((intent # NoRequest) ~> (caller = "done"))
StartedAttemptFinishes == CallerContinues => ((outcome = "active") ~> Terminal)

Init ==
    /\ outcome = "notStarted" /\ phase = "idle" /\ reason = "none"
    /\ attempt = 0 /\ round = 0 /\ differences = 0
    /\ cleanup = "dormant" /\ cleanupReason = "none" /\ cleanupTry = 0
    /\ intent = NoRequest /\ wire = NoRequest /\ caller = "idle" /\ reply = "none"
    /\ hidden = "absent" /\ named = "absent"
    /\ foreignContent = named /\ initialNamed = named
    /\ hiddenVerified = FALSE /\ namedVerified = FALSE /\ publicationVerified = FALSE
    /\ publications = 0 /\ copies = 0 /\ activeCopies = 0
    /\ spool = TRUE /\ keepElapsed = FALSE /\ running = TRUE /\ replayed = FALSE
    /\ execution = NoRequest

\* Start and retry are caller choices; attempts are bounded only for exploration.
Start ==
    /\ running /\ outcome = "notStarted"
    /\ outcome' = "active" /\ phase' = "inspect" /\ attempt' = 1 /\ round' = 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reason, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply,
                   hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified,
                   publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

RetryDelivery ==
    /\ running /\ outcome = "failed" /\ attempt < MaxAttempts
    /\ outcome' = "active" /\ reason' = "none" /\ attempt' = attempt + 1
    /\ round' = 1 /\ differences' = 0 /\ hiddenVerified' = FALSE
    /\ phase' = IF hidden = "absent" THEN "inspect" ELSE "preclean"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, hidden, named,
                   foreignContent, initialNamed, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

Issue ==
    /\ running /\ intent = NoRequest /\ (outcome = "active" \/ cleanup = "active")
    /\ LET r == CASE phase \in {"inspect", "inspectTaken"} -> Request("compareNamed", FinalName, phase)
                     [] phase = "preclean" -> Request("removeHidden", HiddenName, phase)
                     [] phase = "copy" -> Request("copy", HiddenName, phase)
                     [] phase = "verify" -> Request("compareHidden", HiddenName, phase)
                     [] phase = "discard" -> Request("removeHidden", HiddenName, phase)
                     [] phase = "publish" -> Request("publish", FinalName, phase)
                     [] phase = "retention" -> Request("removeSpool", SpoolName, phase)
       IN intent' = r /\ wire' = r
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

Resend ==
    /\ running /\ intent # NoRequest /\ wire = NoRequest
    /\ wire' = intent
    /\ replayed' = (replayed \/ (intent.kind = "publish" /\ reply = "ok"))
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

\* The caller adapter executes an identity once, caches its result, and shares
\* an in-flight copy with all repetitions. These are the settled caller rules.
BeginCopy ==
    /\ wire.kind = "copy" /\ caller = "idle"
    /\ caller' = "busy" /\ hidden' = "partial" /\ activeCopies' = 1 /\ copies' = copies + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, reply, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ execution' = wire

FinishCopy(result, content) ==
    /\ caller = "busy"
    /\ result \in {"ok", "folderGone", "folderFull"}
    /\ content \in IF result = "ok" THEN {"same", "different"} ELSE {"partial"}
    /\ reply' = result /\ hidden' = content
    /\ caller' = "done" /\ activeCopies' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

ExecuteOther(r) ==
    /\ wire # NoRequest /\ wire.kind # "copy" /\ caller = "idle"
    /\ caller' = "done"
    /\ r \in CASE wire.kind = "compareNamed" -> {named, "folderGone", "folderFull"}
                     [] wire.kind = "compareHidden" -> {hidden, "folderGone", "folderFull"}
                     [] wire.kind = "publish" -> {IF named = "absent" THEN "ok" ELSE "taken", "folderGone", "folderFull"}
                     [] wire.kind = "removeHidden" -> {"ok", "folderGone", "folderFull"}
                     [] wire.kind = "removeSpool" -> {"ok", "removeFailed"}
    /\ reply' = r
    /\ hidden' = IF r = "ok" /\ wire.kind \in {"publish", "removeHidden"} THEN "absent" ELSE hidden
    /\ named' = IF r = "ok" /\ wire.kind = "publish" THEN hidden ELSE named
    /\ publications' = IF r = "ok" /\ wire.kind = "publish" THEN publications + 1 ELSE publications
    /\ publicationVerified' = IF r = "ok" /\ wire.kind = "publish" THEN hiddenVerified ELSE publicationVerified
    /\ spool' = IF r = "ok" /\ wire.kind = "removeSpool" THEN FALSE ELSE spool
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified,
                   namedVerified, copies, activeCopies, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ execution' = wire

Consume ==
    /\ running /\ intent # NoRequest /\ wire = intent /\ caller = "done"
    /\ intent' = NoRequest /\ wire' = NoRequest /\ caller' = "idle" /\ reply' = "none"
    /\ LET failed == reply \in {"folderGone", "folderFull"}
           success == (phase \in {"inspect", "inspectTaken"} /\ reply = "same") \/ (phase = "publish" /\ reply = "ok")
           conflict == phase \in {"inspect", "inspectTaken"} /\ reply = "different"
           exhausted == phase = "discard" /\ reply = "ok" /\ differences = MaxDifferences
       IN /\ outcome' = IF phase = "retention" THEN outcome
                         ELSE IF failed \/ conflict \/ exhausted THEN "failed"
                         ELSE IF success THEN "handedOver" ELSE outcome
          /\ reason' = IF failed THEN reply ELSE IF conflict THEN "nameConflict"
                        ELSE IF exhausted THEN "differentCopies" ELSE reason
          /\ phase' = IF failed \/ conflict \/ exhausted \/ success \/ phase = "retention" THEN "terminal"
                       ELSE CASE phase = "inspect" -> "copy"
                                 [] phase = "preclean" -> "inspect"
                                 [] phase = "copy" -> "verify"
                                 [] phase = "verify" -> IF reply = "same" THEN "publish" ELSE "discard"
                                 [] phase = "discard" -> "copy"
                                 [] phase = "publish" -> "inspectTaken"
          /\ differences' = IF phase = "verify" /\ reply = "different" THEN differences + 1 ELSE differences
          /\ round' = IF phase = "discard" /\ reply = "ok" /\ ~exhausted THEN round + 1 ELSE round
          /\ hiddenVerified' = IF phase = "verify" /\ reply = "same" THEN TRUE
                                ELSE IF phase \in {"preclean", "discard"} /\ reply = "ok" THEN FALSE
                                ELSE hiddenVerified
          /\ namedVerified' = (namedVerified \/ success)
          /\ cleanup' = IF success THEN "waiting"
                         ELSE IF phase = "retention" THEN IF reply = "ok" THEN "done" ELSE "failed"
                         ELSE cleanup
          /\ cleanupReason' = IF phase = "retention" /\ reply = "removeFailed" THEN "removeFailed" ELSE cleanupReason
    /\ UNCHANGED <<attempt, cleanupTry, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ execution' = NoRequest

BeginRetention ==
    /\ running /\ outcome = "handedOver" /\ cleanup = "waiting" /\ keepElapsed
    /\ cleanup' = "active" /\ cleanupTry' = 1 /\ phase' = "retention"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanupReason, intent, wire,
                   caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified,
                   namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies,
                   spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

RetryCleanup ==
    /\ running /\ cleanup = "failed" /\ cleanupTry < MaxCleanupAttempts
    /\ cleanup' = "active" /\ cleanupReason' = "none" /\ cleanupTry' = cleanupTry + 1 /\ phase' = "retention"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, reason, attempt, round, differences, intent, wire, caller, reply,
                   hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified,
                   publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

\* The environment may take the final name even between its comparison and
\* publication. Publication is non-replacing and reports that collision.
NameAppears(content) ==
    /\ outcome = "active" /\ named = "absent"
    /\ content \in {"same", "different"}
    /\ named' = content /\ foreignContent' = content
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, hidden, initialNamed, hiddenVerified,
                   namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies,
                   spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

RetentionElapsed ==
    /\ ~keepElapsed /\ keepElapsed' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent,
                   initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   copies, activeCopies, spool, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

Crash ==
    /\ running /\ running' = FALSE /\ wire' = NoRequest
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

Resume ==
    /\ ~running /\ running' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

\* Stopping or waiting for the caller is legitimate and never a deadlock.
Wait == UNCHANGED vars

Drive == Issue \/ Resend \/ Consume \/ BeginRetention
IssueProgress == SF_vars(Issue)
ResendProgress == SF_vars(Resend)
ConsumeProgress == SF_vars(Consume)
RetentionProgress == SF_vars(BeginRetention)

\* Single-root exploration: choose a pre-existing file before starting.
InitialFile(content) ==
    /\ outcome = "notStarted" /\ named = "absent"
    /\ content \in {"same", "different"}
    /\ named' = content /\ foreignContent' = content /\ initialNamed' = content
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences,
                   cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply,
                   execution, hidden, hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified,
                   publications, copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>

Next == Start \/ RetryDelivery \/ Issue \/ Resend \/ Consume \/ BeginRetention \/ BeginCopy
        \/ (\E result \in {"ok", "folderGone", "folderFull"}, content \in {"same", "different", "partial"} : FinishCopy(result, content))
        \/ (\E r \in Replies : ExecuteOther(r))
        \/ RetryCleanup
        \/ (\E content \in {"same", "different"} : NameAppears(content))
        \/ (\E content \in {"same", "different"} : InitialFile(content))
        \/ RetentionElapsed \/ Crash \/ Resume \/ Wait

\* Mutation tests emit the unsafe request, before any file effect is needed.
PublishUnchecked ==
    /\ running /\ phase = "verify" /\ intent = NoRequest
    /\ intent' = Request("publish", FinalName, "publish") /\ wire' = intent'
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

RemoveSpoolEarly ==
    /\ running /\ outcome = "active" /\ intent = NoRequest
    /\ intent' = Request("removeSpool", SpoolName, "retention") /\ wire' = intent'
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

RestartAfterUnrecordedPublication ==
    /\ running /\ intent.kind = "publish" /\ reply = "ok" /\ wire = NoRequest
    /\ wire' = Request("copy", HiddenName, "copy")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

CopyWhileBusy ==
    /\ caller = "busy" /\ activeCopies = 1
    /\ activeCopies' = 2
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent,
                   initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   copies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

RemoveUnrelatedFile ==
    /\ running /\ phase = "discard" /\ intent = NoRequest
    /\ intent' = Request("removeHidden", OtherName, "discard") /\ wire' = intent'
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: The hand-over starts in its initial state and proceeds through the modeled core and caller steps.

pins.name: PublicationIsVerified
pins.says: The core requests publication only after the hidden copy was found identical to the spool file, and every publication carries that evidence.

pins.name: SpoolRemovalIsSafe
pins.says: The original is requested for removal or removed only after verified delivery and expiry of its retention time.

pins.name: NoCopyAfterPublication
pins.says: Once the recording has been published, the core never requests another copy, including after an interruption before recording success.

pins.name: OneCopyAtATime
pins.says: At most one copy of the recording is being executed at a time.

pins.name: ReplayKeepsIdentity
pins.says: A repeated request retains the saved operation, names and identity, including while its execution or result is outstanding.

pins.name: OnlyOwnedNames
pins.says: Every request to change or remove a file targets only the appropriate hidden name, recording name or original spool file belonging to this hand-over.

pins.name: CopiesAreHidden
pins.says: Every copy request uses the hand-over’s hidden name with a leading dot.

pins.name: NewCopiesStartCleanly
pins.says: A new copy is requested only after any previous hidden copy has been removed.

pins.name: DifferenceLimitStopsCopying
pins.says: Reaching the configured limit of differing copies permits only their cleanup before the attempt finishes.

pins.name: AtMostOnePublication
pins.says: The recording is published at most once across all interruptions and retries.

pins.name: ForeignFileIsPreserved
pins.says: A file already occupying the final name is never replaced or removed by this hand-over.

pins.name: SuccessHasEvidence
pins.says: A successful hand-over has an identical file at its final name and recorded verification evidence.

pins.name: FailureKeepsSpool
pins.says: A failed hand-over records its reason and retains the original spool file.

pins.name: DifferentCopyIsNotPublished
pins.says: A differing hidden copy never carries permission to be published.

pins.name: DifferenceLimitCleansUp
pins.says: An attempt that fails for exhausting its differing-copy limit has removed the last differing copy.

pins.name: ExistingMatchAvoidsCopy
pins.says: An identical file present at the final name when the hand-over begins is accepted without making a copy.

pins.name: CleanupCannotUndoDelivery
pins.says: Waiting for retention, removing the original, or failing and retrying that removal leaves the hand-over successful.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: Every state component stays within its declared type and exploration bounds.

pins.name: NewFailuresEndAttempt
pins.says: Handling an absent taken name, a missing copy at publication or a permanent folder refusal ends that attempt with its distinct reason, no outstanding request and the original kept.

pins.name: HiddenComparisonAnswers
pins.says: A hidden-copy comparison answers same or different, including different for an absent copy, unless it reports a folder failure.

pins.name: RetryClearsVerification
pins.says: A new attempt clears previous hidden-copy verification and starts by cleaning any remaining hidden copy before inspecting the final name.

pins.name: OnlyOwnedComparisons
pins.says: Comparison requests in the folder target only the hand-over’s hidden name or recording name.

pins.name: PersistedNumbersCompatible
pins.says: Every existing reason and answer keeps its v0.1.0 numeric value, and each new value is distinct and greater than every existing value of its kind.

pins.name: DeliveredByCopy
pins.says: A new copy can be verified and published while the original remains in the spool.

pins.name: AcceptedExisting
pins.says: An identical existing file can be accepted without copying.

pins.name: ConflictingName
pins.says: A differing existing file can cause a name-conflict failure while remaining unchanged.

pins.name: FolderGone
pins.says: A missing folder can end the hand-over with that failure reason.

pins.name: FolderFull
pins.says: A full folder can end the hand-over with that failure reason.

pins.name: DifferencesExhausted
pins.says: Repeated differing copies can reach the limit, be cleaned up and produce the specified failure.

pins.name: ReplacedDifferentCopy
pins.says: A differing copy can be removed and replaced by a copy that is successfully handed over.

pins.name: RetriedDelivery
pins.says: A failed hand-over can be retried successfully.

pins.name: RecoveredPublication
pins.says: An interruption after publication but before recording success can be recovered by repeating the original request.

pins.name: RetainingOriginal
pins.says: A successful hand-over can retain its original while the retention time has not elapsed.

pins.name: OriginalRemoved
pins.says: The original can be removed after successful hand-over and expiry of retention.

pins.name: CleanupFailed
pins.says: Removal of the original can fail while the hand-over stays successful and the original remains.

pins.name: CleanupRetried
pins.says: A failed removal of the original can be retried successfully.

pins.name: IssueProgress
pins.says: If issuing the next saved request is possible repeatedly, the core eventually issues it.

pins.name: ResendProgress
pins.says: If repeating an interrupted request is possible repeatedly, the core eventually repeats it.

pins.name: ConsumeProgress
pins.says: If recording a completed caller result is possible repeatedly, the core eventually records it.

pins.name: RetentionProgress
pins.says: If starting original removal after retention is possible repeatedly, the core eventually starts it.

pins.name: StartedAttemptFinishes
pins.says: If execution keeps resuming and the caller eventually answers outstanding requests, each started attempt eventually reports success or failure.

pins.name: PublishUnchecked
pins.says: The core requests publication before comparing the copy.

pins.name: RemoveSpoolEarly
pins.says: The core requests removal of the original before delivery.

pins.name: RestartAfterUnrecordedPublication
pins.says: After an interrupted publication, recovery requests a fresh copy instead of repeating the saved publication request.

pins.name: CopyWhileBusy
pins.says: A second copy is started while the first copy is still in progress.

pins.name: RemoveUnrelatedFile
pins.says: Discarding a differing copy mistakenly requests removal of an unrelated file.

pins.name: NameFreedFailure
pins.says: A taken name can disappear before comparison and end the attempt with the name-freed reason and the original kept.

pins.name: CopyGoneFailure

pins.name: FolderRefusedFailure
pins.says: A permanently refused folder step can end the attempt with the folder-refused reason and the original kept.

pins.name: FolderRefusedAtPublication

pins.name: MissingHiddenDiffers

pins.name: RetryAfterNameFreed

pins.name: RetryAfterCopyGone

pins.name: RetryAfterFolderRefusal
